node.title: Direct-E1 route-uniform exceptional-set control
node.statement: Uniformly for every admissible clean-anchor row in the independently defined pair-feasible direct-E1 class B=F_p(Q), |B|>=b_pair_min(K,B*)=ceil((K+B*+1)/3), with all field, embedding, owner, and endpoint data pinned, let quotient orders N in {256,512}, K=A_2(N,ell), and P=sum_y binom(r_y,2) count unordered pairs of distinct characteristic-zero classes colliding after reduction. By e1_pair_feasible_prime_field_reduction every such named-anchor row has q=p and p=1 mod N. Exact folded-norm arguments force collision distance s>=5 for N=256 and s>=2 for N=512. Prove P<=K-B*-1 for B*=floor(|F|/2^128). The formerly printed {128,256} are folded dimensions, not live quotient orders. Finite selected-field exhibit certificates do not discharge this route-uniform target.
node.attack_surface: prove the exact pair-feasible-class incidence bound, construct a pair-feasible row above allowance, or give a complete per-input image/collision certifier theorem
node.falsifier: a pair-feasible candidate row with P>K-B*-1; a certifier leaving such a row uncovered; or any base/ambient-field normalization failure
node.notes: EXACT FINITE RE-POSE 2026-07-26, narrowed 2026-07-28: replaces negligible/o(1) language, fixes quotient-order versus folded-dimension notation, proves that the live branch is prime-field, excludes s<=4 at N=256 and s=1 at N=512 by exact folded norms, and closes profile (3,4,0) through V=26. Square-mass reconciliation proves three other feasible S=16 profiles remain outside that descent, so V=24 computation is paused in favor of an aggregate incidence or direct-image theorem. Selected-field exhibits remain evidence only, and unsafe_crossing_family_instantiation owns global row routing.
